# NOTE: This CMakeLists.txt has NOT been build-verified on this machine.
# There is no native Windows compiler (no cl.exe/msbuild) available in this
# environment, and `flutter create --platforms=windows` refuses to scaffold
# a native template here. It closely mirrors the standard CMakeLists.txt
# generated by `flutter create --template=plugin --platforms=windows` for a
# federated Windows plugin (see any `flutter create -t plugin` output, or
# published examples such as `file_selector_windows`/`url_launcher_windows`
# on pub.dev) and needs a real Windows build (local or CI) to confirm it
# actually configures/compiles.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
set(PROJECT_NAME "attachment_engine_windows")
project(${PROJECT_NAME} LANGUAGES CXX)

# This value is used when generating builds using this plugin, so it must
# not be changed.
set(PLUGIN_NAME "attachment_engine_windows_plugin")

add_library(${PLUGIN_NAME} SHARED
  "attachment_engine_windows_plugin.cpp"
  "share_channel.cpp"
  "audio_channel.cpp"
  "video_channel.cpp"
)

apply_standard_settings(${PLUGIN_NAME})
set_target_properties(${PLUGIN_NAME} PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
target_compile_definitions(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE FLUTTER_PLUGIN_IMPL)
target_include_directories(${PLUGIN_NAME} INTERFACE
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE flutter flutter_wrapper_plugin)

# COM/WinRT interop for Share (shobjidl_core.h / DataTransferManager) and
# Media Foundation for audio/video playback.
target_link_libraries(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE
  runtimeobject.lib   # WinRT activation (RoInitialize / RoGetActivationFactory)
  mfplat.lib          # Media Foundation platform APIs
  mf.lib
  mfreadwrite.lib
  mfuuid.lib
  shlwapi.lib
)

# List of absolute paths to libraries that should be bundled with the plugin.
set(attachment_engine_windows_bundled_libraries
  ""
  PARENT_SCOPE
)
